notice.accepted.title: File requests accepted
notice.accepted.body: KDE Connect accepted the file requests. Delivery is unknown. Check Activity for details.
notice.failed.title: File submission failed
notice.failed.body: Some file requests failed. Check Activity before you retry.
notice.unknown.title: File submission unknown
notice.unknown.body: Check Activity and the recipient for duplicates before you retry.
notice.cancelled.title: Pending files cancelled
notice.cancelled.body: Plus stopped the pending requests. Earlier accepted files can still arrive. Check Activity.
notice.unconfirmed.title: File cancellation unconfirmed
notice.unconfirmed.body: Files can still arrive. Check Activity and native KDE Connect progress.
notice.unavailable: Desktop notice unavailable. Check the submission activity below.
notice.enabled.label: Show task notices
notice.enabled.help: Show a desktop notice after a file operation when the Plus popup, Send window and image preview are closed. Desktop Do Not Disturb and notification history apply. Acceptance does not confirm delivery.
notice.deviceName.label: Include device name in task notices
notice.deviceName.help: Off by default. On adds the reviewed device name to desktop notices and their history. File names and message content stay excluded. KDE Connect owns phone notification forwarding and permissions.
navigation.draft: Draft for %1 · Open Send to review.
navigation.cancelHelp: Stops the Plus queue and active submission. An accepted LAN transfer must be cancelled in KDE Connect's transfer progress. Bluetooth cancellation is not available here.
navigation.choose: Choose Devices, Send, Activity or Plus settings.
navigation.keyboardHelp: Opens the daily view menu. Use arrows to choose, Enter to open, or Escape to return.
navigation.settingsHelp: Plus settings: appearance, connections and device features.
navigation.sendHelp: Review files or text for the selected device.
navigation.activityHelp: Review KDE submission results. Delivery remains unknown.
layout.editorHelp: Set visibility or move each section below. All sections stay available here. Changes apply to every device. Loading data matches neither availability condition.
layout.resetOrderHelp: Reset order only. Keep visibility and expansion preferences.
layout.invalidVisibility: Saved section visibility is invalid. Earlier visibility choices are in use. Edit layout to save a valid choice.
layout.useSavedHelp: Stop waiting for the previous request. Use the currently displayed host settings before making another change.
layout.settingsHelp: Edit section visibility and order in Devices. Hidden sections stay available while editing.
layout.shortcutHelp: Show the pencil beside Plus settings. You can always open the layout editor here.
layout.visibilityHelp: Saved display policy. Checking data matches neither availability condition.
layout.positionHelp: Move this section to a saved position. Hidden sections keep their positions.

files.chooseHelp: Choose files in the file picker. Cancel below stops this selection.
files.previewHelp: Choose your image in the preview window. Back to files returns to the list; Cancel clears this selection.
files.reviewSummary:
%1 · %2
Review the recipient and files, then select Send.
settings.title: Omaconnect KDE Plus Settings
settings.scope: Plus preferences apply to this computer only.
settings.appearanceHelp: Icons, names and section order change how Plus looks. Pairing stays the same.
settings.renameHostHelp: To change this computer’s KDE Connect name, open Native KDE Connect settings in Device features, then choose Settings in the native app menu.
settings.deviceIcon: Change selected device icon and alias
settings.chooseDevice: Choose a device above to change its icon or local name.
settings.iconsGuideAccessible: Open the local icon and contribution guide
settings.batteryIcon: Show battery beside the bar icon
settings.batteryIconHelp: Shows the selected device's charge next to the bar icon when the device reports it.
settings.connectionsHelp: These Plus switches only show or hide controls. To enable KDE Connect connection providers, open Native KDE Connect settings in Device features, then choose Settings in the native app menu.
settings.bthPathHelp: Optional. Use the full path to your Back to Home script, ending in /remote-access-mode. Leave empty to use ~/.local/bin/remote-access-mode.
settings.desktopChooserHelp: Off uses the Omarchy recent-file menu with file icons and Image previews. On opens the desktop chooser for any local file and multiple selections.
settings.reviewFilesHelp: Off sends files when you select them in the chooser. On shows a recipient and file review with a Send button. Drops always need review. Cancel pending work in Send. After acceptance, use KDE Connect's LAN progress Cancel; Bluetooth cancellation is unavailable here.
settings.pingDefaultHelp: Fills in a new Ping message. You can edit it before you send.
settings.batteryHelp: Shows charge and charging state when the device reports them.
settings.mobileNetworkHelp: Shows the phone's mobile network type and signal, not Wi-Fi or VPN.
settings.helpViewer: Opens local documentation in your default viewer.
settings.helpAccessible.appearance: Open the installed task guide for appearance
settings.helpAccessible.connections: Open the installed task guide for connections
settings.helpAccessible.quickActions: Open the installed task guide for quick actions
settings.helpAccessible.deviceFeatures: Open the installed task guide for device features
layout.startExpandedHelp: Sets the initial state when Devices opens. You can expand or collapse this section without changing its saved visibility.
layout.defaultsHelp: These defaults apply when Devices opens. To change visibility or order, select Edit layout in Devices.
